#!/bin/bash
# Filename: interact
# Description: SLURM srun wrapper with defaults and optional config file 
#       support to simplify interactive job execution


# Define paths to required utilities
SCONTROL=/usr/bin/scontrol
LOGGER=/usr/bin/logger
# Variables for readability
TRUE=0
FALSE=1
MAX_TIME='8:00:00'
MAX_SMALL_TIME="00:30:00"
DEBUG=$FALSE
GPU=$FALSE
MODE='bridges'
NOCONFIG=$FALSE

# Declare two associative arrays to hold settings for later application
declare -A CL_SETTINGS
declare -A GPU_SETTINGS


############################################################################## 
# Print command line usage
############################################################################## 
function prnt_usage {
cat <<EOF

Usage:  interact [OPTIONS]
  -A Account/ChargeID   ChargeID if not your default"
    --account
  -d                    Turn on debugging information
    --debug
  --noconfig            Do not process config files
  -gpu                  Allocate 1 gpu in the GPU-shared partition
    --gpu
  --gres=<list>         Specifies a comma delimited list of generic consumable
                          resources. e.g.:    --gres=gpu:1
  --mem=<MB>            Real memory required per node in MegaBytes
  -N Nodes              Number of nodes
    --nodes
  -n NTasks             Number of tasks (spread over all Nodes) 
  --ntasks-per-node=<ntasks>    Number of tasks, 1 per core per node. 
  -p Partition          Partition/queue you would like to run on
    --partition
  -R Reservation        Reservation you would like to run on
    --reservation
  -t Time               Set a limit on the total run time. Format include
                          mins, mins:secs, hours:mins:secs.  e.g. 1:30:00 
    --time
  -h                    Print this help message
    -?

EOF
}


############################################################################## 
# Print information only if debugging is enabled
############################################################################## 
function pdebug () {
    [ $DEBUG -eq $FALSE ] && return
    (>&2 echo $1)
}


############################################################################## 
# Convert HH:MM:SS time specification to number of seconds
############################################################################## 
function seconds_in_time () {
    require perl
    local SECONDS=`echo $1 | perl -ne '@parts=split(":",$_,3); scalar(@parts) > 1 ? print 0 + pop(@parts) + 60 * pop(@parts) + 3600 * pop(@parts) : print 0 + 60* pop(@parts);'`
    if [ -z $SECONDS ] || [ $SECONDS -le 0 ] ; then
        echo "ERROR: could not convert $1 into # seconds"
        exit 1
    fi
    echo $SECONDS
}

############################################################################## 
# Enforce dependencies
############################################################################## 
function require () {
    local TOOL=$1
    # Return TRUE if the command exists and is executable
    if [ -n $TOOL ] ; then
        local TOOL_PATH=`which $TOOL 2>/dev/null`
        [ -n $TOOL_PATH ] && [ -x $TOOL_PATH ] && return $TRUE
    fi
    echo -e "\nERROR: unable to access required utility $TOOL"
    exit 1
}


############################################################################## 
# Check if a reservation is specified in a config file and is currently active
############################################################################## 
function try_config () {

    # Check if the potential config file exists; return otherwise
    local CONFIG_FILE=$1
    if [ $NOCONFIG -eq $TRUE ] ; then
	echo "skipping config file $CONFIG_FILE"
	return $FALSE;
    fi
    pdebug "Checking for $CONFIG_FILE"
    if [ ! -r $CONFIG_FILE ] ; then
        return $FALSE;
    fi

    # Check for a reservation in the config file
    require perl
    RES=$(perl -ne 'if ($_ =~ /^SALLOC_RESERVATION=(.*)/) {print $1 ; exit ; }' < $CONFIG_FILE )

    # If a reservation was specified, but is NOT active, then don't apply the
    # config file as other values may be stale also
    if [ -n "$RES" ]; then
        require $SCONTROL
        local STATE=$($SCONTROL show reservation=$RES | sed -n -e 's/^\(.*\)\(State=\)\(.*\ \)\(BurstBuffer.*\)$/\3/p')
        [ -z "$STATE" ] && STATE='INACTIVE'
        pdebug "Reservation '$RES' in $CONFIG_FILE is $STATE"
        if [ $STATE == 'INACTIVE' ] ; then
            echo -e "\nSkipping $CONFIG_FILE as specified reservation '$RES' is $STATE"
            return $FALSE
        fi
    fi

    # If there was no reservation or it was valid--apply the config
    echo "Sourcing $CONFIG_FILE"
    . $CONFIG_FILE
    return $TRUE 
}


############################################################################## 
# Apply settings from config file, if found and valid
############################################################################## 
function apply_config_file {
 
    # Apply a configuration file if specifies a currently active reservation

    # If GPU nodes were specified, look for a GPU-specific config file
    # Preferentially use a per-user file if it exists and has an active
    # reservation; otherwise use a per-group config file, if it exists and
    # has an active reservation
    if [ $GPU -ne $TRUE ] ; then 
        try_config "$HOME/.config/interact/interact.conf" && return
        for GRP in $(id -Gn) ; do
            try_config "/opt/packages/interact/config/${GRP}.conf" && return
        done
    elif [ $MODE == 'bridges' ]; then
        try_config "$HOME/.config/interact/interact-gpu.conf" && return
        for GRP in $(id -Gn) ; do
            try_config "/opt/packages/interact/config/${GRP}-gpu.conf" && return
        done
    fi

    pdebug "No valid per-user or group configuration file found"
}



############################################################################## 
# Apply command line parameters previously recorded
############################################################################## 
function apply_command_line_settings {

    #Apply all command line settings to override environment and config file
    for VAR in "${!CL_SETTINGS[@]}" ; do 
        pdebug "Apply CL:  $VAR -> ${CL_SETTINGS[$VAR]}"
        eval "$VAR=${CL_SETTINGS[$VAR]}"        
    done

    # Apply default GPU-related settings if the config file only did not already
    # set them
	if [ $MODE == 'bridges' ] ; then
		for VAR in "${!GPU_SETTINGS[@]}" ; do
			eval "VAL=\$$VAR"
			if [ -n "$VAL" ] ; then
				pdebug "$VAR set by config or CL, skipping GPU default"
			else
				pdebug "Setting $VAR to GPU default of ${GPU_SETTINGS[$VAR]}"
				eval "$VAR=${GPU_SETTINGS[$VAR]}"
			fi
		done
	elif [ $MODE == 'olympus' ] ; then
		echo -n
		#TODO: figure out if there are useful GPU defaults for Olympus
	fi
}


############################################################################## 
# Evaluate and record settings from command line options
############################################################################## 
function process_args {
    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
        opt="$1" 
        case $opt in
            -A|--account)
                CL_SETTINGS[SALLOC_ACCOUNT]=$2
                shift 
                ;;
            -d|--debug)
                DEBUG=$TRUE
                ;;
	    --noconfig)
		NOCONFIG=$TRUE
		;;
            -gpu|--gpu)
                # Clear settings and store defaults for application later (unless
                # they are set by config file)
                unset SALLOC_PARTITION SALLOC_NTASKS_PER_NODE SALLOC_NTASKS SALLOC_JOB_NUM_NODES
		OPTS="$OPTS --partition=GPU-small,GPU-shared --gpus=v100:1"
                GPU_SETTINGS['SALLOC_PARTITION']="GPU"
                GPU_SETTINGS['SALLOC_NTASKS_PER_NODE']=16
                GPU_SETTINGS['SALLOC_JOB_NUM_NODES']=1
#		GPU_SETTINGS['SALLOC_GRES']='gpu:v100:1'
                GPU=$TRUE
                ;;
            --gres=?*)
                #gres=${1#*=}
                OPTS="$opt $OPTS"
                ;;
            --mem=?*)
                #mem=${1#*=} 
                OPTS="$opt $OPTS"
                #SLURM_NTASKS_PER_NODE=1
                ;;
            -N|--nodes)
                CL_SETTINGS['SALLOC_JOB_NUM_NODES']=$2
		OPTS="$OPTS --nodes=$2"
                shift
                ;;
            -n|ntasks)
                CL_SETTINGS['SALLOC_NTASKS']=$2
		NTASKS_SET=1
		OPTS="$OPTS --ntasks=$2"
                shift
                ;;
            --ntasks-per-node=?*)
                #SLURM_NTASKS_PER_NODE=$2 
		NT=${1#*=}
		OPTS="$OPTS --ntasks-per-node=$NT"
                ;;
            -p|--partition)
		OPTS="$OPTS --partition=$2"
		SALLOC_PARTITION=$2
                shift
                ;;
            -R|--reservation)
		OPTS="$OPTS --reservation=$2"
                shift   
                ;;
            -t|--time)
		OPTS="$OPTS --time=$2"
                #Convert HH:MM:SS format to number of seconds and compare to limit
                timeinsec=$( seconds_in_time $2 )
                if [ $timeinsec -eq 0 ]; then
                    echo "Incorrect usage: -t"
                    prnt_usage
                fi 
                MAX_SECONDS=$( seconds_in_time $MAX_TIME )
                if [ $timeinsec -gt $MAX_SECONDS ]; then
                    echo "Interactive access is limited to $MAX_TIME hours"
                    exit 1
                fi
                shift
                ;;
            -h|-\?)
                prnt_usage
                exit 1
                ;;
            *)
                echo -e "\nERROR: unsupported option $opt"
                prnt_usage
                exit 1
                ;;
        esac
  
        shift
    done

}


############################################################################## 
# Main script body
############################################################################## 


# Set default partiion, time and job name
SALLOC_JOB_NAME=${SALLOC_JOB_NAME:-Interact}
SALLOC_TIMELIMIT=${SALLOC_TIMELIMIT:-60}

# OPTS=""

# Take command line parameters into account
if [ $# -gt 0 ] ; then
    process_args $*
fi

# Apply config file settings (if present and valid)
apply_config_file

# Apply command line specified options to override config file
apply_command_line_settings

if [[ -z "$SALLOC_PARTITION" ]]; then
	SALLOC_PARTITION="RM-small,RM-shared"
	OPTS="$OPTS --partition RM-small,RM-shared"
fi

# Apply some default values if they weren't set via command line or config file
SALLOC_ACCOUNT=${SALLOC_ACCOUNT:-""}
SALLOC_JOB_NUM_NODES=${SALLOC_JOB_NUM_NODES:-}
SALLOC_NTASKS_PER_NODE=${SALLOC_NTASKS_PER_NODE:-}

# since salloc doesn't have an environment variable for "NTASKS", we check
# for it here and substitute the command line flag instead

if [[ ! -z "$SALLOC_NTASKS"  && ! "$NTASKS_SET" ]]; then
	OPTS="$OPTS --ntasks $SALLOC_NTASKS"
fi

# Lookup the user's default shell and assemble the command line
SHELL=`getent passwd $USER | awk -F/ '{print $NF}'`
require $SHELL
require "srun"
require "salloc"
# CMD="srun $OPTS --pty $SHELL"
CMD="salloc -J Interact $OPTS"

#if [[ $timeinsec -lt 3601 && $SLURM_PARTITION =~ RM.* ]]; then
#    SLURM_PARTITION=RM-debug
#fi
#
#if [[ $SLURM_JOB_NUM_NODES > 1 || $SLURM_NTASKS > 28 && $SLURM_PARTITION =~ .*-.* ]]; then
#  SLURM_PARTITION=${SLURM_PARTITION%-*}
#fi


# Export pertinent variables for reference by the job
for svar in SALLOC_ACCOUNT SALLOC_JOB_NUM_NODES SALLOC_NTASKS SALLOC_NTASKS_PER_NODE SALLOC_PARTITION SALLOC_RESERVATION SALLOC_TIMELIMIT SALLOC_JOB_NAME SALLOC_GRES; do
  [[ ! -z ${!svar} ]] && export $svar
done

# Print pertinent variables and the command line to be run if debugging
if [ $DEBUG -eq $TRUE ]; then
    pdebug "Account:$SALLOC_ACCOUNT Nodes:$SALLOC_JOB_NUM_NODES Ntasks:$SALLOC_NTASKS Partition:$SALLOC_PARTITION Res:$SALLOC_RESERVATION Time:$SALLOC_TIMELIMIT ntasks-per-node:$SALLOC_NTASKS_PER_NODE OPTS:$OPTS MODE:$MODE" >&2
    DATA=`set| grep ^SALLOC | awk '{ORS=" "; print $1 }'`
    pdebug "$DATA"
    pdebug "$CMD"
fi 

# Finally--invoke srun to start the job!
echo ""
echo "A command prompt will appear when your session begins"
echo "\"Ctrl+d\" or \"exit\" will end your session"
echo ""

echo $OPTS
echo $CMD
$CMD
